<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>A 4-bit sequence detector to detect the sequence '1001'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">The active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">A 1-bit input data stream.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">A 1-bit output indicating if the sequence was detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        <parameter_description>
            <parameter name="IDLE">Waiting for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
            <parameter name="S1">Detected the first bit of the sequence.</parameter>
            <parameter name="S2">Detected the second bit of the sequence.</parameter>
            <parameter name="S3">Detected the third bit of the sequence.</parameter>
            <parameter name="S4">Detected the fourth bit of the sequence.</parameter>
        </parameter_description>
        
        // Declare state register
        reg [2:0] current_state;
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or the negative edge of reset
        always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
            // Check for the negative edge of reset to return to initial state
            if (!reset_n) begin
                current_state <= 3'd0;  // Reset the state to IDLE (000)
            end else begin
                case(current_state)
                    // Default case to handle unexpected states
                    default: current_state <= 3'd0;  // Set to IDLE state
                    // Transition rules for each state
                    3'd0: current_state <= data_in ? 3'd1 : 3'd0;  // S1 = 001 if data_in is 1, otherwise stay in IDLE
                    3'd1: current_state <= ~data_in ? 3'd2 : 3'd0;  // S2 = 010 if data_in is 0, otherwise go back to IDLE
                    3'd2: current_state <= data_in ? 3'd3 : 3'd0;  // S3 = 011 if data_in is 1, otherwise go back to IDLE
                    3'd3: current_state <= ~data_in ? 3'd4 : 3'd0;  // S4 = 100 if data_in is 0, otherwise go back to IDLE
                    3'd4: current_state <= 3'd0;  // Stay in S4 after detecting the last bit
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic to assert the output signal based on the current state
        assign sequence_detected = (current_state == 3'd4);
    </implementation>
</module>
